messages:
Jamie Nguyen: getting multiple customer reports of 401s + huge p99 for API calls that should be pinned to eu-central. started ~08:15 UTC.
Laura (support): customer says requests are routed to us-west instead, tokens are failing validation there. they forwarded x-region: eu and x-cid headers.
Jamie Nguyen: can you drop the raw headers they sent?
Laura (support): pasted below — small redacted:
```
GET /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
X-Region: eu-central-1
X-Request-ID: r-9a1b
```

Siva R.: seeing same from telemetry — a subset of requests with X-Region=eu-* are hitting cluster "default-us-west". p50 fine, p99 jumps 3-4s and 401s spike.
Jamie Nguyen: @Ops Oncall can you check recent gateway route changes?
Ops Oncall: deploy-bot shows a route tweak at 08:10 UTC — changed L7 virtual host match to include a new header-based rewrite for legacy tenants.
deploy-bot: DEployed by ci/cd @rev: a3f7 — route: add header_rewrite on request headers to normalize Host for legacy.
Siva R.: I think the header_rewrite is dropping X-Region or rewriting :authority -> api.redwood.ai: that makes Envoy pick default vhost cluster in us-west. reproducing locally now.
Jamie Nguyen: steps to reproduce?
Siva R.: curl sample:
```
curl -v -H "Host: api.redwood.ai" -H "X-Region: eu-central-1" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://gateway.redwood.ai/v1/generate"
```
when route rewrite is enabled envoy returns 302 -> upstream in us-west, token verification fails. if I remove header_rewrite it stays in eu.
Laura (support): customer workaround: add X-Prefer-Region header set to eu-central-1 and traffic stays correct for now.
Jamie Nguyen: ok escalate: rolling back the header_rewrite on gateway. @Ops Oncall please coordinate rollback and add canary check for X-Region passthrough.
Ops Oncall: rolling back now, will monitor metrics for next 15m. :rotating_light:
Siva R.: will open a bug on envoy L7 header_rewrite behavior — looks like a config ordering bug where :authority rewrite is evaluated before region routing. adding repro snippet and trace.
Laura (support): passing this to customer, noted workaround. thanks team. :thumbsup:
